# Prepared archives

Current package: [iteathen-isomax-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz](iteathen-isomax-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz).
Extract the complete `package/` folder, then run `node verify.mjs` and
`node run.mjs`. No installation is needed. See its README for memory and affinity.
Registry publication remains disabled.

[SHA256SUMS](SHA256SUMS) covers the current and historical archives. Earlier archives and their verification records remain preserved for recovery and comparison.

[VERIFICATION-0.2.0-rc.2.json](VERIFICATION-0.2.0-rc.2.json) records current
qualification, including a standalone extracted empty-board solve. The older
0.1.x and 0.2.0-rc.1 archives and verification files are historical.
